answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a continuous service plume: every identity must emit a plume of micro-deliveries, at least 24 per epoch, each staked with a 0.5-unit bond returned only after a client confirms the work. A gap of 6 hours breaks the plume and resets standing to zero. A sable-black ledger records every plume, so clones sharing one delivery stream are spotted instantly. The pearl is scale: 100 fakes must fund 2,400 staked deliveries per epoch and lose 50 units per rejected batch, so a swarm pays money for every fake while one honest agent pays pennies.
